result.title: A Canary in the Neural Mine: Catching an Image Classifier's Silent, Confident Failures
result.summary: Deployed vision models auto-accept confident predictions, so high-confidence errors propagate silently. Maximum Softmax Probability (MSP), the standard failure predictor, has a structural blind spot: as a scalar read from the classifier head, it is first-order blind to feature variation orthogonal to its confidence gradient. Through a factorial analysis of feature-space detectors, we identify a conditional-redundancy principle explaining why they fail to complement MSP: the class-separability geometry they measure is already encoded in MSP and collapses under fusion. The signal that survives is class-conditional typicality on the off-manifold residual---and because this residual's distribution varies by backbone, from near-Gaussian to heavy-tailed, it must be estimated non-parametrically. We instantiate these findings as CANARY, a training-free detector that computes a per-class kNN distance on the PCA residual of the penultimate feature, percentile-calibrates it on validation data, and fuses it with MSP through a single validation-tuned weight. CANARY's benefit follows a headroom law: gains grow as baseline MSP quality falls, so a single clean-validation number forecasts the improvement. With every parameter selected on in-distribution data alone, CANARY matches or improves 382 of 385 shift cells (e-AURC; 379 on AUROC) across five backbones, with worst-case regression within seed noise ($-0.0002$ AUROC) and the largest gains on natural distribution shifts (ImageNet-A/R, ObjectNet)---where deployed models are most exposed.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出最大 softmax 概率（MSP）作为标量置信度对与置信梯度正交的特征变化存在结构性盲区，据此提出免训练的检测器 CANARY：在倒数第二层特征的 PCA 残差上计算类条件 kNN 距离，用验证集做分位校准，再以单一验证调优权重与 MSP 融合，并在五种骨干与多种分布偏移上验证其多数情形匹配或优于基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 「标量置信度遗漏偏离流形的特征残差」这一观察及免训练的校准—融合流程，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 状态是否可靠、以及 STOP 决策何时不宜仅依赖置信度提供辅助信号，但该信号在推理轨迹与多模态表示上是否仍有判别力尚需核查。
